text: Entry Requirements 1.Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign passports; must comply with Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China. 2.Friendly to China, no criminal record, and willing to comply with Chinese laws and NKU’s regulations. 3.Physically and mentally healthy,meeting the medical examination standards for a Chinese study visa or residence permit. 4.High school graduate; Aged 18 to 50. Applicants under 18 must submit the Application Materials for Admission Under 18 and the Guardian Authorization Letter.
